_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The model picker's overlay stays on screen on a narrow viewport. The screen is 360x760. To "open the model picker": wait for ".header" to be visible; when the window is narrower than 768px, the picker is in the overflow menu: if ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, click the button with aria-label exactly "More options", then click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".chat-overflow-popover"; on a wider window, click the visible ".model-picker.p-select" inside ".status-bar". The element clicked is "the picker"; its panel is ".model-picker-panel". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}} and open the model picker. 2. The panel and its first ".p-select-option" should be visible. 3. With B = the panel's getBoundingClientRect(): B.x >= 0, B.x + B.width <= 360, B.y >= 0 and B.y + B.height <= 760. 4. The panel's "input" should be visible.
